target.purpose: Prevent bounded or simulation evidence from being promoted into stronger claim maturity without claim-scoped, quorum-valid, active evidence and dependencies.
target.central_bottleneck: Receipt kinds alone are insufficient when evidence can come from a different claim/source or when prerequisite grants remain trusted after revocation or expiry.
success: Claim stages remain ordered SIM -> TESTED -> INTEGRATED -> PRODUCTION_CLAIM.
Every counted receipt binds claim_id, repository, and source_sha.
Destination-stage evidence kinds meet a positive unique-signer quorum.
Future, revoked, malformed, and out-of-scope receipts do not count.
Promotion decisions bind exact claim, policy, evidence, and prerequisite-grant identities.
Time-bounded grants become invalid when supporting evidence or prerequisite grants are revoked.
Claim IDs cannot be rebound to different repository/source identity.
Python and Node preserve the same scoped evidence/quorum stage ceiling.

invariants: stage progression is ordered and destination-evidence-bound
receipt scope is claim_id + repository + source_sha
required quorum is a positive integer and counts unique signers per evidence kind
future and revoked evidence fail closed
prerequisites count only while their grants remain active and stage-sufficient
PRODUCTION_CLAIM is claim maturity and not production-control authority

donor_plan.basis: This repository owns claim-evidence promotion semantics; the actuation receipt bus owns lifecycle evidence and remains separate.

nonclaims: reference claim-governance system, not production Colossus control
no sibling integration without executable composition proof
